about.label: About Morso
about.body: Morso recommends recipes based on your diet, allergens, and preferences — a personalized dashboard of eligible recipes you can save for later and log what you cook.

howItWorks.title: How Morso learns you
howItWorks.subtitle: There's no long survey to get right. The more you use Morso, the better it gets.

use.title: You use Morso
use.caption: Cook, save, skip, rate — every action is a signal.

signal.title: We catch the signal
signal.caption: Your taste profile quietly updates in the background.

sharpen.title: Recommendations sharpen
sharpen.caption: Tomorrow's picks fit you a little better than today's.

howItWorks.footer: …and the cycle repeats every time you open Morso.

preferences.title: Allergies and diet
preferences.subtitle: Allergies come first. They permanently filter matching ingredients out of everything we show you. You can always update these later from your Profile.

allergies.heading: Any allergies?
allergies.description: Choose a category, then check off the specific items that apply. This is the main safeguard that keeps unsafe recipes off your dashboard.
allergies.otherDescription: Not listed above? Add specific foods or food groups, separated by commas (e.g. “kiwi, shellfish”).

diets.heading: Any diets that apply to you?
diets.description: Pick as many as you like. No restrictions is fine too, you can leave this blank.

personalize.title: Personalize
personalize.subtitle: Rarely to constantly. Defaults are fine if you're not sure, you can always tweak this later.

signalBanner.title: Use → Signal → Sharper picks
signalBanner.description: These sliders are just a starting point — Morso keeps learning from what you actually cook.

feedback.label: Don't see something you eat a lot?
feedback.description: Tell us and we'll work on adding it. Optional.

personalization.subheading: Update your diet, allergies, and taste preferences any time. Changes apply to your dashboard right away.

howMorsoLearns.title: How Morso learns you
howMorsoLearns.body: Every rating, save, and skip below feeds your taste profile — recommendations sharpen the more you use Morso.

allergies.otherHelp: List specific foods or food groups, separated by commas (e.g. “kiwi, shellfish”).

diets.title: Any diets that apply to you?
diets.body: Pick as many as you like. No restrictions is fine too, you can leave this blank.

spice.title: How much heat can you handle?
spice.body: We won't surface anything spicier than this. Recipes we haven't rated for heat still show up either way.

foodGroups.title: How much do you eat these?
foodGroups.body: Rarely to constantly. This nudges which recipes we show you first, it never rules anything out.
